name: microtel
description: Lightweight OpenTelemetry-compatible runtime and OTLP exporter for traces, metrics and logs (OTLP/HTTP and OTLP/gRPC) built on nghttp2, without the gRPC or protobuf C++ libraries.
license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT AND CC0-1.0

concentrator.description: Experimental concentrator leaf receiver (MICROTEL_WITH_CONCENTRATOR): parses untrusted leaf bytes with upb's decoder

leaf.description: Experimental leaf C library for microcontrollers (MICROTEL_BUILD_LEAF, nanopb backend), exported as microtel::leaf

spdlog.description: Record MICROTEL_USE_SPDLOG=ON and provide spdlog for the header-only spdlog log bridge (include/microtel/adapters/spdlog_sink.hpp)
